description: This EA trails the stop-loss of an existing position using the ATR_Trailing custom indicator. It does not open new positions—it only modifies the SL of already-open buy or sell positions based on ATR-derived trailing levels. The EA operates on a per-bar basis, recalculating the trailing stop only when a new bar appears.

name: K_eSimpleMA
author: tsaktuo
description: This EA trades based on a dual EMA crossover strategy, going long when a faster EMA crosses above a slower EMA and going short on the opposite crossover. name: EA_AML_1-01

It opens buy or sell positions when the AML value lies within the bar's open-close range, and optionally reverses positions on opposite signals. Position sizing can be dynamically adjusted based on account balance relative to a maximum drawdown threshold.

name: TradePad
description: TradePad is a graphical trade panel EA that provides a visual interface (TradePanel) on the chart for manual trading operations. It uses a timer to update the panel display and delegates all chart events, ticks, and trade events to the CTradePanel object. It does not open positions based on its own strategy signals; it serves as a semi-automated trading dashboard.

author: Copyright © 2011, Nikolay Kositsin

The strategy also searches historical bars for close signals when no direct close signal is generated on the current bar.

name: Exp_3Parabolic
author: Copyright © 2011, Nikolay Kositsin
description: This EA uses three Parabolic SAR indicators on different timeframes (H6, H3, H1) to generate trading signals. A buy signal occurs when all three SARs are below their respective close prices and the fastest SAR just flipped from above to below. Sell signals follow the inverse logic. Positions are managed with fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, with optional money management based on deposit share or fixed lot size.

name: Exp_3rdGenerationXMA
author: Copyright © 2012, Nikolay Kositsin

name: Exp_BBands_Stop

description: This EA trades Bollinger Band breakout signals using the BBands_Stop_v1 custom indicator. It opens long positions when the upper band activates and short positions when the lower band activates, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. Position sizing supports either a fixed lot size or a percentage of the deposit.

name: Exp_BBSqueeze

description: This EA trades based on the BBSqueeze (Bollinger Band Squeeze) indicator, detecting volatility contraction breakouts. name: Exp_Bezier

It opens buy positions when the indicator crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit. The EA supports multiple smoothing methods (EMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) for flexible indicator customization.

name: Exp_i-CAi_StDev
description: This EA trades based on the i-CAi_StDev custom indicator, which combines a CXMA smoothed moving average with standard deviation channels. It opens and closes positions using three signal modes: point signals from indicator arrows, direct analysis of the indicator line direction, or disabled signals, with configurable buy/sell open and close logic operating independently.

name: Exp_PFE
description: This EA trades based on the Polarized Fractal Efficiency (PFE) indicator, opening buy positions when PFE turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward. It uses smoothing algorithms (JJMA by default) to filter the PFE signal and employs a new-bar check to avoid redundant trade execution. Position sizing supports multiple margin modes with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.

name: Exp_PFE_Extr
description: This EA trades based on the Polarized Fractal Efficiency (PFE) indicator, opening buy positions when PFE crosses above the upper level and sell positions when it crosses below the lower level. It uses a smoothed PFE value with configurable moving average methods and applies money management rules for position sizing. The strategy closes opposite-direction positions on new signals and supports separate toggles for entry and exit logic.

name: Exp_PPO_Cloud
description: This EA trades based on the PPO (Percentage Price Oscillator) Cloud indicator, entering long when the PPO line crosses above the signal line and short when it crosses below. It uses a customizable smoothing method for the fast, slow, and signal lines, and manages positions with fixed StopLoss and TakeProfit levels. Trade execution is gated by new bar detection to avoid redundant signals on the same bar.

name: Exp_CandlesticksBW
description: This EA trades based on the CandlesticksBW custom indicator, which classifies candlestick patterns into numeric zones. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals bullish patterns (value transitions from zone <2 to >1) and sell positions when it signals bearish patterns (value transitions from zone >3 to <4), with optional position closing on reverse signals.

name: Exp_RAVI_Histogram
description: This EA trades based on the RAVI (Range Action Verification Index) Histogram custom indicator, opening buy positions when the indicator crosses above the upper threshold level and sell positions when it crosses below the lower threshold level. It uses dual smoothed moving averages (fast and slow) to compute the RAVI value and applies configurable money management modes for position sizing. Positions are closed on opposing signals when the indicator reverses back through the threshold levels.

name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI
description: This EA trades based on crossover signals from the i-SpectrAnalysis_RVI custom indicator, which applies spectral (Fourier) analysis to the RVI (Relative Vigor Index). It opens buy positions when the RVI main line crosses above its signal line and sell positions on the reverse crossover, with configurable entry/exit toggles and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels.

name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_WPR
description: This EA trades based on a spectral analysis filter applied to the Williams Percent Range (WPR) indicator. It opens buy positions when the filtered WPR value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels.

name: Exp_wlxBW5Zone
description: This EA trades based on the wlxBW5Zone custom indicator, which identifies Bill Williams zone signals for buy and sell entries. It opens and closes positions systematically when the indicator generates up or down zone signals, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.

name: Exp_BalanceOfPower_Histogram
description: This EA trades based on the Balance of Power histogram indicator, entering buy positions when the histogram rises (bullish momentum increasing) and sell positions when it falls (bearish momentum increasing). It uses customizable smoothing (default T3) on the BOP values and supports configurable money management, stop loss, and take profit.

name: Exp_i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin
description: This EA trades based on the i-SpectrAnalysis_Chaikin custom indicator, which applies spectral (Fourier) analysis to the Chaikin Oscillator. It opens buy positions when the spectrally-filtered Chaikin value turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable money management and stop-loss/take-profit levels.

name: Exp_RVIDiff
description: This EA trades based on the RVIDiff custom indicator, which is a smoothed Relative Vigor Index (RVI) with additional moving average smoothing. It opens buy positions when the RVI value rises above its previous value in a downtrend, and sell positions when it falls below its previous value in an uptrend. Positions are closed on opposing signals with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Oschenker FibonacciRetracement
author: Oschenker
description: This EA uses ZigZag indicator to identify swing highs and lows, then draws Fibonacci retracement levels on the most recent ZigZag leg. It enters buy trades when price bounces above a Fibonacci level in an uptrend, and sell trades when price falls below a Fibonacci level in a downtrend, with fixed stop-loss and Fibonacci-extension-based take-profit.

name: Exp_STLMCandle
description: This EA trades based on the STLMCandle custom indicator, which appears to be a JMA-based smoothed trend candlestick indicator. It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend (color value 2) and sell positions when it signals a downtrend (color value 0), with optional position closing on trend reversal signals.

name: Exp_StochasticDiff
description: This EA trades based on the StochasticDiff custom indicator, which applies an additional smoothing (T3 by default) to the standard Stochastic oscillator. It opens buy positions when the smoothed Stochastic turns upward and sell positions when it turns downward, with configurable entry/exit toggles and money management options.

name: synccharts

name: Exp_ColorXvaMA_Digit

It opens buy positions when the indicator signals an uptrend and sell positions when it signals a downtrend, with configurable stop loss and take profit levels. The EA operates on new bar events and uses money management modes for position sizing.

name: HelloSmart

The EA is designed to protect profits in trending markets by dynamically tightening stops as price moves favorably.

name: Exp_ColorJSatl_Digit

It opens buy positions when the indicator turns bullish (color change upward) and sell positions when it turns bearish (color change downward), with configurable position management parameters.

name: Exp_Waddah_Attar_Trend
description: This EA is based on the Waddah Attar Trend indicator, which combines MACD and Bollinger Band principles to detect trend direction and strength. It automatically opens buy positions when a bullish trend is detected and sell positions when a bearish trend is detected, with configurable take-profit and stop-loss levels. The EA operates systematically on each new bar, evaluating the trend indicator values to make trading decisions without manual intervention.

name: Exp_i4_DRF_v2
description: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor based on the i4 (Intraday Intuition) indicator with DRF (Dynamic Range Filter) enhancements. It identifies trend direction using a combination of range-filtered price action and momentum signals, entering trades in the direction of the prevailing trend with dynamic stop-loss and take-profit levels.

name: Exp_JSatlCandle
description: This EA is a trend-following expert advisor based on the JSatlCandle custom indicator, which likely combines digital filter (Jurus) and SATL (Slow Adaptive Trend Line) concepts to generate candlestick-based trend signals. It systematically opens buy or sell positions when the indicator confirms a trend direction, and manages exits via opposing signals or fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels.

name: Exp_Bear_Bulls_Power
description: This EA trades based on the Bears Power and Bulls Power indicators developed by Alexander Elder. It enters long when Bulls Power is positive and rising while Bears Power fades, and enters short when Bears Power is negative and falling while Bulls Power fades, using EMA as a trend filter.

name: Exp_i4_DRF_v3
description: This EA implements a mean reversion strategy based on the i4 indicator (a dynamic range filter) that identifies overbought and oversold conditions relative to a calculated central tendency. It enters trades when price deviates significantly from the range and exits upon reversion to the mean or via stop loss/take profit. Version 3 includes refined filter logic and improved exit conditions over prior iterations.

name: Exp_ColorXvaMA_Digit_StDev
description: This EA trades based on the ColorXvaMA_Digit indicator with Standard Deviation filtration. It opens buy positions when the indicator changes to an upward color and sell positions when it changes to a downward color, using StDev as a volatility filter to confirm trend strength before entry.

name: Exp_Delta_RSI
description: This EA trades based on the Delta RSI indicator, which measures the difference between two RSI periods to detect momentum shifts. It opens buy positions when the Delta RSI crosses above a threshold and sell positions when it crosses below, using fixed lot sizing with stop loss and take profit levels.

name: Exp_Delta_MFI
description: This EA trades based on the Delta MFI (Market Facilitation Index) indicator, which measures the rate of change of MFI to detect momentum shifts. It enters long positions when Delta MFI turns positive and rising, and short positions when Delta MFI turns negative and falling, using fixed lot sizing and stop levels.

name: Exp_Delta_WPR
description: This EA trades based on the Delta WPR (Williams' Percent Range) indicator, which measures the rate of change (delta) of the WPR oscillator. It enters long positions when the WPR delta signals oversold reversal conditions and short positions when it signals overbought reversal conditions, exploiting mean reversion dynamics of the Williams Percent Range indicator.

name: Exp_RSI_Slowdown
description: This EA trades based on RSI slowdown signals, detecting when the RSI indicator loses momentum in overbought or oversold zones and entering reversal trades accordingly. It systematically opens positions when RSI divergence or deceleration patterns are identified, aiming to capture trend exhaustion and subsequent reversals.

name: Exp_WPR_Slowdown
description: This EA trades based on the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) indicator, entering positions when WPR signals a slowdown or reversal from extreme overbought/oversold zones. It systematically opens buy trades when WPR exits the oversold region and sell trades when WPR exits the overbought region, aiming to capture mean reversion moves. The EA includes customizable WPR period, overbought/oversold thresholds, and basic risk management parameters.

name: Exp_MFI_Slowdown
description: This EA trades based on Money Flow Index (MFI) slowdown signals, detecting when the MFI indicator momentum decelerates near overbought or oversold zones to anticipate potential reversals. It enters positions when MFI shows signs of losing directional strength after reaching extreme levels, aiming to capture the subsequent price reversal. The strategy systematically opens buy trades near oversold slowdowns and sell trades near overbought slowdowns.

name: Exp_Trigger_Line
description: This EA trades based on the Trigger Line indicator, which uses smoothed moving average crossovers to identify trend direction. It opens buy positions when the fast trigger line crosses above the slow trigger line and sell positions on the opposite crossover. The system includes basic stop loss and take profit management for each trade.

name: Exp_XMACandles
description: This EA trades based on the XMACandles indicator, which colors candles according to moving average momentum direction. It opens buy positions when momentum shifts bullish and sell positions when momentum shifts bearish, with configurable stop loss, take profit, and trailing stop management.

name: exp_x2ma_jfatl
description: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover system combined with the JFATL (Jurik Fast Adaptive Trend Line) indicator to generate trend-following trade signals. It enters long positions when the faster MA crosses above the slower MA confirmed by JFATL direction, and enters short positions on the opposite crossover. Exits are triggered on reverse crossover signals or stop loss/take profit levels.

name: Multi Lot Scalper
author: Copyright © 2005, Alejandro Galindo
description: This EA is a scalping system that uses a martingale position sizing approach, doubling lot size after each losing trade while aiming for small take-profit targets. It opens market orders based on simple price action or indicator signals and relies on the martingale recovery logic rather than stop-losses for risk management. The strategy targets small pip gains on each trade, assuming that a winning trade will eventually recover previous losses.

name: exp_x2ma_jjrsx
description: This EA combines a double moving average (x2ma) crossover system with Jurik RSX momentum filtering to generate trend-following trade signals. It enters long when the faster MA crosses above the slower MA and RSX confirms upward momentum, and enters short on the reverse conditions. Positions are managed with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: exp_x2ma_digit_dm_361
description: This EA trades based on a dual moving average crossover system with digital signal filtering and directional movement confirmation. It opens positions when the fast MA crosses the slow MA and the digital filter validates the signal direction. Exits are managed through a combination of MA crossover reversal and fixed stop-loss/take-profit levels.

name: CyberiaTrader
author: Copyright c 2006, Cyberia Decisions
description: CyberiaTrader is a momentum-based Expert Advisor that identifies rapid price movement impulses and trades in the direction of the momentum spike. It uses a proprietary impulse detection algorithm to capture short-term directional moves, entering quickly when momentum exceeds a calculated threshold and exiting on momentum decay or fixed take-profit/stop-loss levels. The EA is designed for high-frequency trading on liquid instruments with tight spreads.

name: DayTrading
author: Copyright © 2005, NazFunds Company
description: DayTrading is an Expert Advisor designed for intraday scalping on lower timeframes, executing trades based on short-term price action and technical indicator signals. It aims to capture small price movements within the trading day, typically closing all positions before the session ends to avoid overnight risk. The EA combines momentum and trend filters to identify high-probability entry points with tight take-profit targets.

name: 20 200 expert v 4.2 AntS
author: Smirnov Pavel
description: This EA implements a grid trading strategy using two moving averages (20-period and 200-period) as trend filters, placing pending orders at fixed intervals in the direction of the trend. Version 4.2 with AntS modifier suggests an enhanced variant with anti-spike or anti-spread protection features. The EA systematically opens grid positions when price moves within the trend channel defined by the two MAs.

name: e-Regr
author: © 2008 BJF Trading Group
description: e-Regr is an Expert Advisor based on linear regression channel analysis for mean reversion trading. It identifies price deviations from the regression line and enters trades when price reaches the channel boundaries, expecting a return to the mean. The EA uses the regression channel slope to filter trend direction and manages positions with configurable stop loss and take profit levels.

name: The MasterMind 2
author: Copyright © 2008, CreativeSilence, Inc.
description: The MasterMind 2 is a Martingale-based Expert Advisor that doubles lot size after each losing trade in an attempt to recover losses. It enters positions based on simple momentum or trend signals and relies on the Martingale progression to achieve net profitability. The EA lacks meaningful stop-loss protection and carries extreme risk of account blowout during extended losing streaks.

The EA continuously adapts by retraining the network on recent price history at configurable intervals.

author: Copyright © 2016, Vladimir Karputov
description: This EA automatically opens and closes trades at specified times of day, allowing the user to define exact hours and minutes for entry and exit. It operates on a time-based schedule without any technical indicator signals, purely relying on the broker's server time to trigger positions. The EA supports configurable lot size, stop loss, take profit, and magic number for order identification.

name: exp_3sto
description: This EA uses a triple Stochastic Oscillator system across different timeframes or parameters to generate trading signals. It enters long when all three Stochastic indicators align in oversold territory and signal bullish reversal, and enters short when they align in overbought territory signaling bearish reversal. The strategy is a multi-confirmation momentum system that requires agreement across three Stochastic readings before opening a position.

name: exp_3rvi
description: This EA is based on the 3RVI (Triple Relative Vigor Index) strategy, using three RVI indicators with different periods to generate trading signals. It opens buy positions when all three RVI signal lines align upward and sell positions when they align downward, aiming to capture momentum shifts with triple confirmation.

It targets small pip gains with quick entries and exits, typical of M5 scalping strategies. The EA automates the entire trade lifecycle from signal detection through position management.

The EA acts as a trailing stop and risk management overlay for other trading strategies.

author: Ron Thompson
description: This EA implements a dual moving average crossover strategy, commonly known as the 'Bunny Cross', which generates buy signals when a fast moving average crosses above a slow moving average and sell signals on the reverse crossover. It is a systematic trend-following system that enters positions on MA crossover signals and manages exits via stop loss and take profit levels. The strategy aims to capture trending market moves while filtering out some noise through the dual MA confirmation.

The EA name suggests precision entry and exit targeting similar to a surgical scalpel approach.

description: This EA is a trailing stop utility that modifies existing positions' stop-loss levels to follow price movement, locking in profits as the market moves favorably. It does not open any new trades on its own but manages already-opened positions by dynamically adjusting their stop-loss based on configurable trailing parameters. The tool is designed to protect gains while allowing positions to run as long as the trend continues.

name: Exp_ReOpenPositions
description: This EA is a position management utility that automatically re-opens closed positions based on configurable rules. It monitors existing trades and, when they are closed (by TP, SL, or manually), can re-establish positions according to the original or updated parameters. It does not generate its own trading signals but rather manages the lifecycle of positions opened by other strategies or manually.

author: Coders Guru
description: This EA implements a dual EMA crossover strategy that opens buy positions when the short EMA crosses above the long EMA and sell positions when it crosses below. It includes fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels plus a trailing stop feature to protect profits on open positions. A Reverse input allows inverting the signal direction for contrarian trading.

author: FORTRADER.RU
description: This EA combines Parabolic SAR (iSAR) with Fibonacci levels to identify trend direction and potential entry points. It uses the Parabolic SAR indicator to determine trend direction and Fibonacci retracement or extension levels as entry triggers. Trades are opened when price action at Fibonacci levels aligns with the SAR trend signal.

name: Exp_RSI
description: Exp_RSI is an Expert Advisor based on the RSI (Relative Strength Index) indicator that opens buy positions when RSI indicates oversold conditions and sell positions when RSI indicates overbought conditions. It implements a classic mean reversion strategy expecting price to return to its average after reaching extreme RSI levels. The EA includes configurable RSI period, overbought/oversold thresholds, and basic position management parameters.

name: Exp_MFI
description: This EA trades based on the Money Flow Index (MFI) indicator, opening buy positions when MFI crosses below the oversold level and sell positions when MFI crosses above the overbought level. It uses fixed lot sizing and configurable overbought/oversold thresholds to generate systematic entry signals. The strategy is a classic momentum-based mean-reversion approach using volume-weighted RSI logic.

author: MetaQuotes Software Corp.

It operates within the MQL5 Standard Library Expert Advisor framework, delegating signal generation, trailing, and position sizing to modular components.

name: TurtleTrader
author: Oschenker
description: This EA implements the classic Turtle Trading system based on Donchian Channel breakouts. It enters long when price breaks above the N-day high and enters short when price breaks below the N-day low, using ATR-based position sizing and a pyramiding approach. Exits are triggered by opposite breakout signals or trailing stops based on a shorter period.

name: Exp_WPR
description: This EA trades based on the Williams' Percent Range (WPR) oscillator, entering long positions when WPR indicates oversold conditions and short positions when it indicates overbought conditions. It uses configurable overbought and oversold threshold levels to generate entry signals and applies fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels for trade management. The strategy is a classic mean reversion approach expecting price to revert from extreme readings back toward normal levels.

description: This EA trades based on the Color JFATL (Jurik Fast Adaptive Trend Line) digital indicator signals, entering positions when the colored trend line changes direction. It features a ReOpen mechanism that adds to existing positions when the trend signal persists or reconfirms, allowing pyramiding along the established trend direction.

name: Simple FX
author: Copyright © 2007, GLENNBACON.COM LLC
description: Simple FX is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average crossovers to identify trend direction and generate buy/sell signals. It enters long positions when a fast moving average crosses above a slow moving average, and enters short positions on the reverse crossover. The EA includes basic stop-loss and take-profit functionality for trade management.

name: Exp_Bezier_ReOpen
description: This EA trades based on Bezier curve (polynomial interpolation) signals to identify trend direction changes, with a ReOpen feature that allows re-entering positions after a closed trade if the Bezier signal remains valid. It opens positions along the detected trend direction and manages them using the Bezier curve's slope and curvature as directional indicators.

name: Opening and Closing on Time v2
author: Copyright © 2016, Vladimir Karputov
description: This EA opens and closes positions based on predefined time windows, allowing traders to automate trading during specific market sessions or time periods. It places buy or sell orders at configured start times and automatically closes all positions at a specified end time, making it a time-based session trading system.

author: The # one Lotfy
description: This EA uses CCI and MACD indicators to generate trading signals, entering buy positions when both indicators are deeply oversold and sell positions when both are deeply overbought. It employs a Martingale position sizing scheme, doubling the lot size after each losing trade (via the m_pos counter), and resetting to base lot after a winning trade. The EA also includes a closing mechanism for profitable positions that have moved 120 points in favor.

description: This EA trades based on the JBrainTrend1 indicator, which is a trend-following stop-and-reverse system that generates buy/sell signals when the trend direction changes. It features a ReOpen mechanism that allows re-entering positions in the same trend direction after a stop-out, aiming to capture the remainder of a trend move.

name: VR SETKA 3
author: Copyright © 2012, WWW.TRADING-GO.RU .
description: VR SETKA 3 is a grid trading Expert Advisor that places a network of pending buy and sell orders at fixed price intervals around the current market price. It profits from market fluctuations by capturing small movements within the grid spacing, while exposing the account to significant drawdown risk when the market trends strongly in one direction. The EA is a classic grid system without stop losses on individual orders.

name: Expert_NEWS
author: Copyright © 2014, cmillion@narod.ru
description: This EA trades around scheduled economic news events by placing pending orders before news releases and managing them based on the resulting market volatility spike. It uses a straddle-style approach with buy-stop and sell-stop orders placed at a configurable distance from the current price before the news time. After the news event triggers a directional move, one order is activated while the opposite order is deleted, capturing the breakout momentum generated by the news surprise.

name: MACD Stochastic 2
author: Gordago Software Corp.
description: This EA combines MACD and Stochastic oscillator signals to generate trade entries, using MACD for trend/momentum direction and Stochastic for overbought/oversold confirmation. It opens buy positions when MACD crosses upward and Stochastic is in oversold territory, and sell positions when MACD crosses downward and Stochastic is in overbought territory. The strategy aims to capture momentum shifts confirmed by dual-indicator confluence.

name: Simplest Hedging EA ever
author: Copyright © 2010 - Monu Ogbe
description: This EA implements a straightforward hedging strategy by opening an opposite direction trade whenever an existing position goes into loss, aiming to neutralize drawdown through offsetting positions. It operates on the principle of locking in floating losses by creating a hedge rather than using stop losses. The EA is designed for hedging-enabled accounts and requires manual intervention or external logic to close the hedge pair at profit.

name: TrendMeLeaveMe
author: Copyright © 2007,Eng Waddah Attar
description: TrendMeLeaveMe is a trend-following EA that uses Ichimoku Kinko Hyo indicators to identify trend direction and enter trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It opens positions when price confirms trend alignment across multiple Ichimoku components and manages exits via trailing stops based on the Ichimoku cloud and Chikou span. The EA is designed to ride trends while using the Ichimoku system as both entry filter and dynamic stop-loss mechanism.

name: Frank Ud
description: Frank Ud is a trend-following Expert Advisor for MetaTrader 5 that uses moving average-based signals to identify and ride market trends. It enters positions when trend conditions align and manages trades with configurable stop-loss and take-profit levels. The EA is designed for medium-term trading on major currency pairs.

name: Exp_AdaptiveCGOscillator_X2
description: This EA trades based on the Adaptive CG Oscillator, a cycle-based oscillator that adapts its period to market conditions. It uses a two-stage signal system (X2) where entries are triggered when the oscillator crosses zero or reaches extreme levels, with confirmation from a signal line crossover.

name: Exp_Fractal_RSI
description: This EA combines Fractal breakout signals with RSI momentum filtering to generate trade entries. It opens buy positions when a bullish fractal is confirmed and RSI supports upward momentum, and sells on bearish fractals with RSI confirming downward pressure. Exits are managed via stop-loss and take-profit levels set at entry.

name: Exp_FisherTransform_X2
description: This EA trades based on two Fisher Transform indicators with different periods, entering long when both Fisher signals cross above their thresholds and entering short when both cross below. It uses a fixed lot size with stop loss and take profit, implementing a dual-signal confirmation system for mean reversion entries. The EA operates systematically without manual intervention, opening and closing positions based on the crossover signals from the Fisher Transform oscillator.

name: CrossMA
description: This EA trades based on the crossover of two moving averages (a fast MA and a slow MA). It opens a buy position when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and a sell position when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA, making it a classic trend-following system.

The system includes basic position management and is designed for day-chart swing trading.

description: This EA trades based on the 2pbIdealMA indicator, a smoothed moving average system that identifies trend direction. It features a ReOpen mechanism that allows adding to existing positions when trend signals persist, enabling pyramiding into strong trends. Entries and exits are driven by MA crossover signals with position management logic.

description: This EA uses the Stochastic Oscillator to identify overbought and oversold market conditions, opening buy trades when the Stochastic crosses upward from oversold zones and sell trades when it crosses downward from overbought zones. It is a classic mean-reversion system that expects price to revert to the mean after reaching stochastic extremes. The EA applies fixed lot sizing and relies on stochastic crossover signals for both entry and exit.

name: Stochastic Three Periods
author: Rafael Maia de Amorim
description: This EA uses Stochastic oscillator signals across three different timeframes to generate trade entries and exits. It aligns multiple timeframe momentum readings to filter out false signals and only trades when all three periods confirm the same direction. The strategy enters long when all three Stochastics are oversold and turning up, and short when all three are overbought and turning down.

name: Exp_Zonal_Trading
description: Exp_Zonal_Trading is an Expert Advisor that identifies key trading zones (support/resistance or supply/demand zones) on the chart and executes trades when price interacts with these zones. The EA manages positions with zone-derived stop loss and take profit levels.

description: The Escape EA is a breakout-based trading system that identifies price escaping from a consolidation range and enters trades in the direction of the breakout. It uses a channel or range calculation to define boundaries and triggers entries when price breaks above or below those levels, aiming to capture momentum moves from range expansion periods.

description: A grid trading EA that opens an initial market order when price deviates significantly from recent highs/lows, then places up to 4 limit orders at fixed grid intervals with doubling lot sizes (Martingale-style). It closes all positions and pending orders when total floating profit reaches a target amount, with an optional breakeven stop-loss feature.

It places trades when price pulls back to key Fibonacci levels within an established trend, combining Fibonacci analysis with trend direction filters. The EA manages positions using Fibonacci-based take-profit targets and supports both manual and automated trading modes.

name: MA Cross
description: This EA trades based on moving average crossover signals, going long when a fast MA crosses above a slow MA and going short when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA. description: This EA combines Fractal breakout signals with ADX trend strength filtering and Ichimoku Cloud confirmation to enter trend-following trades.
